message: タヌキの世界

name: Synn
message: 「Ah! Over there, isn't that--」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Azel, good work out there!」
On my way to the Student Council room, I call out to Azel, who is staring blankly at the school building.
Unlike plain rectangular boxes, from the Ereto Dorm to the Auroiaere Dorm, Ryuusei Academy is full of buildings you never get tired of looking at.

name: Azel
message: 「...? I am not tired.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, I mean, good job with KiraFes!」

name: Azel
message: 「I will say it again. I am not tired.」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No, it's just a greeting, I swear!」

name: Azel
message: 「Incomprehensible.」

name: Azel
message: 「This building is even stranger. Why have the decorations vanished?」

name: Synn
message: 「C-Could you be talking about the KiraFes decorations? Those were taken down on Saturday--」

name: Azel
message: 「Saturday was loud.」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, that's because KiraFes was--」

name: Azel
message: 「Sunday was quiet.」

name: Azel
message: 「This building's exterior changed completely on Saturday alone, yet its fundamental structure remains the same. I surmise it is akin to the changing of the four seasons?」

name: Synn
message: 「Aha, ahaha!!」

name: Azel
message: 「Why do you laugh?」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Sorry, ahahahaha, hahaha!」

name: Azel
message: 「I did not ask for an apology. I simply fail to comprehend why you laughed.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hahaha, hahaha! Mm, hmm-hmm! Hah, hah... H-Hearing what you said just reminded me of something funny, Azel.」

name: Azel
message: 「I see. The act of remembering is comprehensible.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, have you ever heard an old folktale like this?」

name: Synn
message: 「A tanuki and a human had a contest to see who was better at tricking the other. The rule was that whoever lost would have their home taken away」

name: Synn
message: 「The human went first」

name: Synn
message: 「In early spring, the human took the tanuki up to the top of a small hill. From there, rice paddies stretched out as far as the eye could see」

name: Synn
message: 「'Over the course of a year, I'll change the colors you see from here. Keep watching from this spot.' Told that, the tanuki decided to gaze out at the scenery from atop the hill」

name: Synn
message: 「The paddies, which had been completely brown, were flooded with water and turned sky blue, and next the rice sprouted and turned yellow-green--」

name: Synn
message: 「In summer they became a deep green, in autumn they turned the golden color of rice ears, and in winter, once harvesting was done, they turned pure white with snow」

name: Synn
message: 「Seeing that sight, the tanuki was shocked. Realizing it was no match at all, it surrendered」

name: Synn
message: 「Even though in truth, the tanuki is actually better at shapeshifting tricks. Ahahaha」

name: Azel
message: 「...I understand」

name: Azel
message: 「Humans deceive tanuki as well, yes? Then the school building's sudden transformation on Saturday alone is synonymous with that」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, a festival is kind of like a fleeting dream, so you could say that」

name: Azel
message: 「A dream...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Though calling it 'tricking' might sound bad to people... What I just told you is a story about a white lie」

name: Azel
message: 「A white lie...?」

name: Azel
message: 「I know... A white lie is a method, a means, a stratagem」

name: Azel
message: 「...Heh, then I too am a white lie」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, she left」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, whatever. I feel like we weren't quite on the same page, but at least I got to talk with Azel」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku, seeing Azel-ko's cluelessness and associating her with a tanuki--just what I'd expect from Master Synn」

name: Synn
message: 「Um... I can't really tell if you're praising me or making fun of me」

name: Paqy
message: 「Neither」

name: Paqy
message: 「Normally you'd compare a young lass to a fox, right? That's got way more flair and class than a tanuki」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, put another way, Azel-ko intuitively coming across like a tanuki just means she's still a total kid」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hmm?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Paqy, whenever you tease Nanaka or Misa, you always crack jokes right in front of them, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Why is it that only with Azel, you wait until she's gone to say anything?」

name: Paqy
message: 「......Brats are scarier than old geezers and grannies in a way, ya know.」

name: Azel
message: 「Hey.」

name: Azel
message: 「What became of the tanuki that lost the contest afterward?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nothing really happened to it? They lived in different worlds to begin with, so there was never any need for humans to take the tanuki's home in the first place.」

name: Azel
message: 「I see. In that case, I am not an expedient. I exist, not as a dream.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, she left again......」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel sure is mysterious, isn't she? Maybe it's because she's an exchange student?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Angels are way easier to figure out. Just lookin' at Aze-ko wears my spirit down.」

name: Paqy
message: 「I'm gonna catch some shut-eye, so wake me up when Ria-chan gets here. *Slump*」

name: Paqy
message: 「Grooooan, grooooan!」
Bringing along Paqy, who is unusually snoring away, I head to the old school building. Alright, time to switch gears and get to Student Council activities.

name: Synn
message: 「Come to think of it......」
I wonder if Azel does any club activities? Next time I get the chance, I'll try asking her.
